summary: Thorough, well‑executed preregistered artifact study that correctly implemented the frozen paired design and exhaustively published reproducibility artifacts. The run and analysis are internally consistent and the manuscript transparently diagnoses why the preregistered shared_initial_candidate semantics produced a degenerate paired outcome. Two preregistration‑requested manuscript clarifications remain outstanding and must be addressed before finalisation.
critical_issues: The manuscript does not satisfy a prior required revision: it fails to state the exact preregistered estimand (that the test evaluates verifier‑consistency under identical inputs, i.e., paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline with shared_initial_candidate semantics) in the title and in the first sentence of the abstract as requested. This omission risks reader misinterpretation of the estimand.

The manuscript lacks the requested concise mapping (short table or boxed bullet) that explicitly contrasts (a) the operational question practitioners typically want (independent per‑condition generative reliability), (b) the preregistered estimand actually tested here (deterministic verifier response to identical canonical candidates), and (c) why the shared_initial_candidate semantics answers the latter but not the former. That mapping was a prior required revision and remains absent.
required_revisions: Revise title and the first sentence of the abstract to explicitly name the preregistered estimand and generation semantics. Include the preregistration field name paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline and the phrase shared_initial_candidate (point to preregistration SHA‑256 7db1663c...). This must be a brief, unambiguous statement in the title or subtitle and the abstract's opening sentence.

Insert a short table or boxed bullet (1 small table or a 4‑line boxed list) that maps: (a) the operational question practitioners need (independent per‑condition generative reliability), (b) the preregistered estimand tested (verifier‑consistency under shared_initial_candidate), and (c) the causal reason the current confirmatory design produced a degenerate paired contingency (identical canonical candidates + deterministic validator). Reference the supporting artifacts (analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv and analysis/condition_summary.csv and example canonical candidate paths execution/responses/*-shared-initial.txt).
optional_revisions: Optionally include a short JSON/text excerpt (one small snippet) from a representative validator trace (e.g., execution/scoring/task-000001-guarded.json) as an in‑paper example to illustrate validator checks (artifact already archived).
Optionally add a short subtitle clarifying the paper is a reproducibility + design‑diagnostic study (not an independent generative‑reliability benchmark) to reduce misreading.
Optionally add a 2–4 line pseudo‑protocol snippet showing the independent_per_condition rerun command sequence and exact artifact paths to help readers execute the proposed rerun deterministically.
